featured_reviews.name: DR IFFAT INAMDAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt note from a happy Billabong parent – Malad branch

The first day at Billabong was nothing short of reassuring. From the moment we stepped in, there was a sense of warmth and belonging. The transition was handled so smoothly – every effort was made to ensure the children felt safe, seen, and supported. My daughter came home beaming with joy and couldn’t stop talking about how much she loved her teacher already.

As a parent, I had been promised not just an excellent curriculum but also genuine care and attention to each child’s individual needs. On day one itself, I could feel those promises taking shape. In a world full of choices and competition, I feel confident that we made the right one.

Looking forward to this journey with Billabong High, Malad – with gratitude and excitement.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you, Dr. Iffat Inamdar, for your heartfelt feedback! We're thrilled that your daughter felt safe and supported on her first day at Billabong High, Malad. Your confidence in our curriculum and care means the world to us. We look forward to sharing this wonderful journey with you!

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Tanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
I studied at Billabong High International School from Junior KG to Grade 10, and it was an incredible journey from start to finish. The environment was warm, welcoming, and always supportive—from the amazing teachers who genuinely cared about our growth, to the joyful memories of playing on the jungle gym in the early years.

What truly sets Billabong apart is how it nurtures every aspect of a student’s development. It’s the place where I discovered and honed many of my core skills—public speaking, leadership, dance, martial arts, and most importantly, empathy. The school never focused only on academics; it focused on shaping well-rounded individuals.

Billabong played a huge role in who I am today. It gave me confidence, discipline, and the space to grow. I’m genuinely grateful for everything this school has given me. Highly recommended for any parent looking for a place where their child can truly thrive—both in learning and in life.

We're thrilled to hear how Billabong High International School fostered your confidence and empathy while nurturing well-rounded individuals. featured_reviews.name: Nisha Sheludkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Orchids International school is one of the best when it comes to balancing strong academics with the overall development of students. The teaching staff is highly qualified, supportive, and ensures that every child understands concepts thoroughly while encouraging curiosity and independent thinking.

Apart from academics, the school places equal importance on co-curricular and extracurricular activities such as sports, arts, music, debates, and cultural events. This gives students ample opportunities to explore their interests, build confidence, and develop important life skills like teamwork, leadership, and creativity.

The environment is safe, nurturing, and student-friendly, with a strong focus on values, discipline, and character building. Regular parent–teacher interactions also help in tracking the child’s progress and supporting their growth at home as well.

Overall, the school provides a holistic learning experience that prepares students not only for academic success but also for life beyond the classroom.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind words. We are delighted to know you value the balanced approach, supportive environment, and holistic learning experience at Orchids.

featured_reviews.name: Trayam's By Saumya
featured_reviews.review_text:
PATHETIC MANAGEMENT
I’m not upset about the admission decision — schools have their own criteria, and that’s understandable. What is completely unacceptable, however, is the utter lack of response despite repeated follow-ups.
After making multiple attempts to get a simple update, I was met with silence. No acknowledgment, no clarity, nothing. For an institution that claims professionalism, this level of disregard for parents’ time and effort is extremely disappointing.
Basic courtesy isn’t too much to expect — even a straightforward rejection would have been appreciated. Ignoring parents after they’ve invested time, effort, and hope reflects very poorly on your system.
I strongly urge the management to address this gap in communication. Parents deserve respect, transparency, and timely responses — not silence.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We sincerely apologize for your experience—this is not the standard of communication we aim to provide. We understand how important timely updates are and regret any inconvenience caused. Kindly share your contact details with us via DM, or write to us at escalations@orchids.edu.in with a detailed description of your concern, along with your contact information. Our team will review the matter promptly and work towards an appropriate resolution.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nostalgia to school days!
St Anne's High School is located in Orlem, Malad (West). They have a computer lab, science laboratory, AV room, library, a big hall and spacious classrooms. One major plus point is that it has a ground of its own. There are many extracurricular activities, inter school competitions, etc which one can be part of during their school days. Overall it's a good school. Most of the teachers are well qualified and know how to make the students understand the things taught. However at times, some teachers behave very abruptly with students, they're always frustrated and have anger issues. There's a difference between being strict and being a good teacher. Some teachers are also partial towards students due to which equal opportunity is not given to all and only their favoured students are seen everywhere, be it academic or non academic related things or competitions. For some reason, the non-teaching staff is always irritated.
